# Contract: `OneKeyFishing/SeedData.lua`

Written by `npm run harvest`, shipped in the package, listed in the TOC before `CatchDB.lua`. Never edited by hand.

```lua
-- Generated by npm run harvest; do not edit.
local _, ns = ...
ns.SeedData = {
  epoch = 4,                 -- grows by 1 with every harvest
  built = "2026-12-01",      -- date of the harvest
  build = "1.60.1",          -- newest game version in the data
  absorbed = {               -- contribution ID -> newest epoch of it summed into this seed
    ["k7f2q9xa"] = 3,
  },
  resets = {                 -- mapID -> first game version whose data counts for that map
    [1415] = "1.60.2",
  },
  cells = {                  -- place key -> cell (data-model.md), keys sorted
    ["1415:3:47"] = { c = 1840, m = 122, t = 61000, px = 902110, py = 1380402, k = 14,
      i = { [6291] = { 912, 1004 }, [6303] = { 655, 655 } } },
  },
}
```

Rules:

- ASCII only, lines up to 120 characters (the generator wraps long `i` lists), sorted keys so a diff shows only real
  changes.
- File size at most 1 MB; `npm run check` fails above it and checks that the file parses and has the fields above.
- The addon reads it at runtime only (no work at file load besides the table constructor); a missing or malformed
  `ns.SeedData` is treated as an empty seed with epoch 0.
- An empty seed (`cells = {}`) is valid; the first seed may be small.
